title: Egyptian blue
ask_addressed: What chemical technologies is ancient Egypt securely documented to have practised: pigments (Egyptian blue, Egyptian green, frit)
quote: Egyptian blue, also called cuprorivaite, is a human-made pigment with the chemical formula CaCuSi4O10.
summary: Encyclopaedic pointer only: identifies Egyptian blue as a synthetic calcium copper silicate. Only the opening sentence was read; no dates or analyses were checked.
limits: Tertiary source, not evidence for dating or technology. Use only to locate primary literature in its reference list.
